title: Meredith's Heart Surgery Dilemma
description: Meredith Grey faces a critical challenge during her first heart surgery when she accidentally nods off, leading to potential complications and a review of her actions.
interfering_episode_characters: Richard Webber; George O'Malley; Derek Shepherd; Mr. Patterson; Miranda Bailey
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith participates in heart surgery and nods off while holding the heart. She worries about damaging the heart due to a torn glove. Mrs. Patterson experiences complications post-surgery. Meredith confesses to Burke about the glove. Burke and Meredith face a review with the chief and legal team.

title: Mrs. Drake's Surgical Error and Hospital Liability
description: The arc follows the discovery of a surgical error from a past operation on Mrs. Drake, leading to a potential liability issue for the hospital and ethical dilemmas for the doctors involved.
main_characters: George O'Malley; Richard Webber; Miranda Bailey; Preston Burke
single_episode_progression_string: George identifies hyperinflated lungs in Mrs. Drake. Richard and Bailey perform surgery and find a towel left inside her chest. Cristina discovers Burke was involved in the previous surgery. Richard emphasizes the hospital's liability. Burke decides to confess about the previous mistake.

title: Jerry Frost's Pain Management and Surgical Complications
description: Derek Shepherd and Alex Karev manage Jerry Frost, a patient with chronic back pain and a history of drug addiction, leading to complications that require immediate surgical intervention.
single_episode_progression_string: Jerry Frost reports chronic back pain and requests specific medications. Derek notices track marks and suspects drug-seeking behavior. Alex and Derek discuss the patient's addiction and pain management. Jerry becomes violent, falls, and sustains a subdural hemorrhage. Derek and Alex perform emergency surgery to address the hemorrhage.

title: Meredith and Derek's Professional and Personal Entanglement
description: Meredith Grey and Derek Shepherd navigate a complex relationship that begins with a one-night stand and evolves as they work together at Seattle Grace Hospital. Their personal history complicates their professional interactions, especially as Meredith strives to prove her competence amidst Derek's favoritism and the eventual arrival of his estranged wife, Addison.
interfering_episode_characters: George O'Malley; Miranda Bailey; Preston Burke; Izzie Stevens; Cristina Yang
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith and Derek share a romantic encounter at a party. Derek notices Meredith's change in attitude when George joins them. Meredith declines Derek's dinner invitation. They flirt and have sex in Derek's car.

title: Meredith Grey's Struggle With Ellis Grey's Legacy
description: Meredith Grey navigates her medical career under the shadow of her mother, Ellis Grey, a legendary surgeon now battling Alzheimer's disease. This arc explores Meredith's struggle to establish her own identity while dealing with the emotional and professional impact of her mother's legacy.
interfering_episode_characters: Ellis Grey; Richard Webber; Preston Burke; George O'Malley; Derek Shepherd; Miranda Bailey
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith visits her mother at the nursing home and discusses signing over her estate. Meredith feels overwhelmed by her mother's condition and her own professional challenges. Meredith worries about her performance in the OR and the potential impact on her career. Meredith confesses to Burke about the torn glove during surgery. Meredith faces a meeting with the chief about her actions in the OR.

title: Interns' Journey and Growth
description: A group of new interns, Meredith, Cristina, George, and Izzie, form a bond as they navigate the challenges of their medical internship. Their evolving friendships provide emotional support and camaraderie, helping them tackle complex medical cases and personal dilemmas. The season showcases their growth through handling difficult cases, supporting each other, and overcoming personal and professional challenges.

Cristina and Burke share a moment over coffee, hinting at a developing relationship. George reassures Meredith about her surgical concerns. The interns clean up after the party, reflecting on their chaotic lives.

title: Izzie Stevens' Professional Challenges
description: Izzie Stevens, an ex-model turned surgical intern, faces professional challenges and biases due to her past. She strives to demonstrate her competence and commitment in the high-pressure environment of Seattle Grace Hospital, advocating for her patients and overcoming personal and professional obstacles.

title: George O'Malley's Journey to Personal and Professional Growth
description: George O'Malley, an intern at Seattle Grace Hospital, faces challenges with personal frustrations, insecurities, and self-doubt as he navigates his medical career. Throughout the season, he learns to assert himself and gradually demonstrates his abilities to his peers and superiors, leading to significant personal and professional growth.

title: Cristina Yang's Ambition: Professional Rivalries and Emotional Detachment
description: Cristina Yang, a highly ambitious surgical intern, navigates her professional journey with a focus on achieving surgical excellence. Her competitive nature often leads to rivalries with her peers, particularly Alex Karev, as they vie for opportunities and recognition. Simultaneously, Cristina struggles with emotional detachment in her pursuit of career advancement, leading to conflicts with her peers and mentors. The season highlights her ambition, the challenges she faces in balancing her personal and professional relationships, and her ongoing struggle to balance ambition with empathy, as seen in her interactions with patients and her peers.

Cristina and Burke have sex in the locker room, highlighting her emotional detachment.

title: Alex Karev's Professional Rivalries and Personal Growth
description: Alex Karev, a surgical intern known for his competitive nature and brash demeanor, often finds himself in professional rivalries with his peers. Throughout the season, he works on developing his skills and improving his bedside manner, learning to balance his skepticism with empathy.
